title: Wilted Vegetable Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy German-inspired stir fry made with wilted vegetables. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Wilted vegetables (such as spinach, kale, or collard greens)
ingredients.notes: Choose your favorite wilted vegetables or use a mix

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add wilted vegetables and cook until heated through.
Sprinkle with flour and stir to combine.
Add Kenyan red pepper and stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
